newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian bourse 9-mo volume already exceeds 95 year.
newsitem.headline: Belgian bourse 9-mo volume already exceeds 95 year.

text.p: The volume of business through the Belgian bourse in the first nine months of this year totalled 604.99 billion francs, already 10.8 percent above the 546 billion francs in all of 1995, the bourse said on Tuesday.
The bourse also said in a statement concerning the month of September that average daily volume through the Brussels market was 2.99 billion francs against 2.28 billion in August.
Total volume during September, it said, was 62.85 billion francs.
